node.statement: Fix U in calU and put S=sigma(U). Conditional on validated nodes 1.4 and 1.5, node 1.5 gives S in calU and U bold-dot S,U^dagger in S_delta. Node 1.4 applied to X=U bold-dot S and X=U^dagger then gives ||u_delta(U bold-dot S)-U bold-dot S||<=84*epsilon_r and ||u_delta(U^dagger)-U^dagger||<=84*epsilon_r. Substituting the definitions of mu and sigma proves ||mu(U,S)-U bold-dot S||<=84*epsilon_r and ||S-U^dagger||<=84*epsilon_r.
